random_forest.limitations: Exploratory diagnostic only; correlated features can share/mask importance, small holdout and random permutations add variability; negative drops are possible. Not causal; no feature selection or retuning.

xgboost.limitations: Exploratory diagnostic only; correlated features can share/mask importance, small holdout and random permutations add variability; negative drops are possible. Not causal; no feature selection or retuning.
xgboost.native_definition: Normalized average split gain (XGBClassifier default gain importance)
